stageA.sourceMathematics: A polygon must be closed with straight sides. Triangle3, quadrilateral4, pentagon5, hexagon6. Four or five segments alone do not ensure a closed polygon.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original warmup Which One Doesn't Belong: images A,C,D are pentagons; B is not closed. Students complete publisher partial shapes into quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon, and draw a different correct instance of each.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Educator reviews actual publisher fragments, completed pencil drawings, closure and unique valid shapes, and partner comparisons.
